description_for_human: Self-hosted OCR, table extraction, and document intelligence engine.
description_for_model: Self-hosted document intelligence and OCR engine. Capable of ONNX-accelerated extraction, table structure extraction to Markdown/HTML, KaTeX math parsing, bounded memory streaming, and PII masking for PDFs and images.
x-status: This project has no hosted deployment at a fixed domain, so 'api.url' below is intentionally relative -- it resolves once you self-host blast_ocr/api/app.py (FastAPI), which serves /openapi.json at its own root. AI agents should prefer the native MCP server (mcp.json) over this legacy ChatGPT-plugin-style manifest.
